reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. The content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and changes in candidate status.
